config_source:
# User-adjustable numerical accuracy protocol. run.py parses this file as DIPL.
unit_conversion_accuracy
  execution
    python_base str = "python3.13"
      ?descr "Python interpreter used to create the isolated pinned environment."

    output_dir str = "benchmarks/unit-conversion-accuracy/results"
      ?descr "Directory for timestamped run outputs, relative to repository root."

    libraries str[:] = ["snt", "pint", "unyt", "astropy"]
      ?descr "Participating unit libraries; each is evaluated against the same reference cases."

    cases str[:] = ["*"]
      ?descr "Case ID patterns. Case definitions and exact expressions are in workload.cases."

    figure_dpi int = 160
      ?descr "Resolution of the summary figure."

  workload
    inputs float[:] = [-40.0, 0.0, 0.1, 10.0, 1000.0]
      ?descr "Input magnitudes exercised in each case, in its declared source unit."

    cases
      scaled_to_micro
        ?descr "SI prefix conversion from metres to micrometres."
        source_unit str = "m"

        target_unit str = "um"

        scale_num int = 1000000

        scale_den int = 1
          ?descr "Exact SI-prefix conversion from metres to micrometres."

      foot_to_metre
        ?descr "International-foot conversion to metres; the foot is exactly 0.3048 m."
        source_unit str = "ft"

        target_unit str = "m"

        scale_num int = 381

        scale_den int = 1250
          ?descr "International foot is exactly 0.3048 m (381/1250)."

      speed_to_kmh
        ?descr "Compound speed conversion from metres per second to kilometres per hour."
        source_unit str = "m/s"

        target_unit str = "km/h"

        scale_num int = 18

        scale_den int = 5
          ?descr "Exact ratio 1 m/s = 3.6 km/h."

      celsius_to_kelvin
        ?descr "Affine temperature-point conversion from Celsius to kelvin."
        source_unit str = "degC"

        target_unit str = "K"

        offset_num int = 27315

        offset_den int = 100
          ?descr "Temperature point conversion: K = degC + 273.15."

      fahrenheit_to_kelvin
        ?descr "Affine temperature-point conversion from Fahrenheit to kelvin."
        source_unit str = "degF"

        target_unit str = "K"

        scale_num int = 5

        scale_den int = 9

        offset_num int = 45967

        offset_den int = 100
          ?descr "Temperature point conversion: K = (degF + 459.67) * 5/9."

  tolerances
    absolute float = 0.0
      ?descr "Absolute error acceptance threshold in the target unit."

    relative float = 0.00000000000001
      ?descr "Relative error acceptance threshold, applied when the reference is nonzero."

    ulp int = 1
      ?descr "Maximum accepted binary64 ULP distance from the correctly rounded reference."

  packages
    snt
      version str = "0.9.11"
        ?descr "Pinned SNT3 package release."
        ?rationale "Release provenance is in the release URL below."

      website str = "https://github.com/scinumtools/snt3"
        ?descr "SNT3 project and source repository."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/scinumtools3/0.9.11/"
        ?descr "Pinned package release page."

    pint
      version str = "0.26.2"
        ?descr "Pinned Pint package release."
        ?rationale "Release provenance is in the release URL below."

      website str = "https://pint.readthedocs.io/en/0.26.2/"
        ?descr "Pint documentation for the pinned release."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/Pint/0.26.2/"
        ?descr "Pinned package release page."

    unyt
      version str = "3.2.0"
        ?descr "Pinned unyt package release."
        ?rationale "Release provenance is in the release URL below."

      website str = "https://unyt.readthedocs.io/en/3.2.0/"
        ?descr "unyt documentation for the pinned release."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/unyt/3.2.0/"
        ?descr "Pinned package release page."

    astropy
      version str = "8.0.2"
        ?descr "Pinned Astropy package release."
        ?rationale "Release provenance is in the release URL below."

      website str = "https://docs.astropy.org/en/8.0.2/"
        ?descr "Astropy documentation for the pinned release."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/astropy/8.0.2/"
        ?descr "Pinned package release page."

    numpy
      version str = "2.5.4"
        ?descr "Pinned NumPy release used for benchmark support and input handling."
        ?rationale "Release provenance is in the release URL below."

      website str = "https://numpy.org/"
        ?descr "NumPy project website."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/numpy/2.5.4/"
        ?descr "Pinned package release page."

    matplotlib
      version str = "3.11.2"
        ?descr "Pinned figure rendering package."
        ?rationale "Release provenance is in the release URL below."

      website str = "https://matplotlib.org/"
        ?descr "Matplotlib project documentation."

      release str = "https://pypi.org/project/matplotlib/3.11.2/"
        ?descr "Pinned package release page."

  provenance
    si_brochure str = "https://www.bipm.org/en/publications/si-brochure"

    foot_definition str = "https://www.nist.gov/pml/special-publication-811"

    error_metrics str = "https://fptalks.org/spec/measures-1.2.html"

    rational_arithmetic str = "https://docs.python.org/3/library/fractions.html"
